tooltip.starcrowndoll.self.lore: I came, I saw, I conquered.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.yule.controls: Press H to open the virtues panel.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.calm.feast: Place and right-click to play Let Me Go. Players and tamed pets within 12 blocks share rice and receive Regeneration II for 8 seconds, once every 60 seconds per target.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.calm.humility: : Take 35% less damage. An ordinary hit can remove at most 40% of your maximum health.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.calm.tolerance: : Create a 12-block peace field for 8 seconds. Ordinary hostiles stop attacking you and your teammates, and their projectiles are intercepted. The cooldown is 45 seconds after the field ends.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.calm.generosity: : Sneak and press Q to give away the selected stack. When another player picks it up, both receive Hero of the Village II for 60 seconds. The gift keeps its item type and quantity. Cooldown: 120 seconds.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.calm.chastity: : Standard negative effects last 60% less time. Water and lava within 3 blocks beneath your feet turn to frosted ice and obsidian. Toggle this in the panel.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.calm.temperance: : Hunger depletes 75% more slowly, and held gear and armor have a 50% chance to skip durability loss.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.calm.charity: : Empty-hand right-click an injured teammate or your tamed pet to heal 40% maximum health and grant Resistance II for 10 seconds. Cooldown: 25 seconds. Sneak-right-click animals or villagers to form up to 3 pacts. Partners within 16 blocks share a 60-second interval and give one ordinary drop or basic trade item.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.calm.diligence: : Work grants Haste IV and Speed II, fading 5 seconds after activity. Earn 1 work point per 16 blocks walked or natural block mined. Every 10 points gives 20 XP. Every 100 permanently adds 1 max health and 0.25 luck, up to +10 health and +2.5 luck.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.twilight.skill1.ef: Reduces ordinary damage by 60% and caps each hit at 35% of your maximum health. Void and instant-kill damage still apply.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.twilight.skill2.ef: Creative flight, +35% movement speed and triple mining speed. Toggle night vision and 3×3×3 or 5×5×5 area mining.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.twilight.skill3.ef: Active melee, ranged and attributable spell damage gains 50%, up to 60 extra damage per hit.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.twilight.skill4.ef: Hostiles that hurt you are marked for 10 seconds. Your next hit triggers four reprisal pulses over four seconds, totaling 12% of the target's maximum health, capped at 120. Twelve-second cooldown per target.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.twilight.skill5.ef: Create a 16-block domain for 10 seconds, pausing ordinary hostile AI and intercepting its projectiles. You and teammates inside take 20% less boss damage. Forty-five-second cooldown after expiration.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.twilight.skill6.ef: Two 64-block safe blink charges, one recharged every 12 seconds. Store three cross-dimensional anchors. A successful return costs 1,000 experience points and triggers a shared 60-second cooldown.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.twilight.skill7.ef: Lethal hits to you, teammates or your tamed pets within 24 blocks use their own totem first. The free rescue restores 40% maximum health and grants three seconds of damage immunity. Both wearer and target have a 180-second cooldown.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.place: Right-click a block: place the doll
tooltip.starcrowndoll.lore: Mortal or immortal, all shall acknowledge your divinity.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.skill1: Mortals! Behold the right to face the blazing sun
tooltip.starcrowndoll.skill1.effect: Wear to enable the unbounded server life reservoir; vanilla health is a display.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.skill1.protect: Reject damage, health overrides, death and ordinary entity deletion; maintain food, air and safe status.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.skill2.travel: Creative flight and optional night vision; movement up to x5 with unrestricted water movement.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.skill2.build: Mining x20, no flight mining penalty, +16 reach; optional area mining.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.skill2.immune: Reject knockback, webs and harmful or neutral effects; clear fire and freezing.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.skill3.effect: Melee, ranged, spell and attributable bonus damage is multiplied by ten and bypasses armor, armor toughness and Resistance on mobs and bosses.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.anchor: Automatic anchor blocks abnormal deletion. Unequip through the normal head slot to release; no commands required.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.music: Right-click to loop music and freeze, bounce and spin mobs within 16 blocks. Right-click again or break the doll to release them.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.yule.lore: Seven virtues bring clarity to heaven and earth
tooltip.starcrowndoll.yule.animation: Palm display, blinking and head sway; arms rise on jumps and lower on landing.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.white_rice.effect: Grants Instant Health XXIX (level 29) when eaten
tooltip.starcrowndoll.yule.feast: While music plays, living creatures and players within 16 blocks eat rice every 1.6 seconds, gaining Instant Health XXIX. Stops outside range or when music ends.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.yule.humility.name: Humility
tooltip.starcrowndoll.yule.humility: : Each hit deals at most 1 damage to you. Hostile creatures have difficulty sensing or targeting you.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.skill2.benefits: Automatically grants enabled beneficial effects at level 255 by default. Use the panel to adjust the level or toggle grants. Beneficial effects from other sources work normally. Keeps the wearer skin visible and hides flames.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.skill4.effect: Attackers are marked. Suppress shields, healing and standard revival; your strikes add 25% max-health damage and execute after four verdicts. Excludes players.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.skill5: All things! Obey my supreme decree
tooltip.starcrowndoll.skill5.effect: Pause mob AI within a 12-block sphere; allies and players are excluded. Restores on leaving or unequipping.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.skill5.domain: Toggle a 64-block domain to prevent hostile attacks, teleportation, spawning and healing; remove hostile projectiles, restrain charges and expel enemies.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.skill6: Stars! Pave my endless way home
tooltip.starcrowndoll.skill6.effect: Safe aimed blink up to 256 blocks, no cooldown. Eight cross-dimensional anchors, return point and death-site travel; safety return after void or abnormal displacement.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.skill7: Time! Preserve all that I cherish
tooltip.starcrowndoll.skill7.effect: Allies within 64 blocks receive automatic lethal-hit totem protection without items or cooldown, plus brief immunity. Player protection can be disabled.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.skill7.verdict: Hits apply Cost for 10 seconds: ten pulses per second, each dealing 20 times the last actual hit. Pulses never refresh the record; potion immunity does not prevent Cost.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.controls: Wear and press H to open the Divine Panel. The key is configurable.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.skill4.authority: Doll wearers who attack you forfeit their authority.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.yule.tolerance: : A peace field within a 48-block horizontal radius turns ordinary zombies into villagers and pacifies other hostiles. Incoming attacks are negated and grant both sides Regeneration X and Absorption X for 10 seconds.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.yule.generosity: : Sneak and press Q to offer a gift. It may become more valuable with its quantity preserved. On pickup by another player or creature, both gain permanent Hero of the Village X and double attributes and effective caps once.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.yule.chastity.name: Chastity
tooltip.starcrowndoll.yule.chastity: : Wards off harmful effects, forms frosted ice on water and obsidian on lava, and purifies undead and Nether creatures within 5 blocks.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.yule.temperance: : Hunger and saturation stay full. Held gear and armor lose no durability. Bows, ender pearls, rockets and block placement preserve their supplies.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.yule.charity.name: Charity
tooltip.starcrowndoll.yule.charity: : Empty-hand right-click an injured creature to fill its health and grant Resistance V for 60 seconds. Sneak and right-click an ordinary animal or villager to form a pact. Partners within 16 blocks offer loot or trade goods once per second.
tooltip.starcrowndoll.yule.diligence: : Movement, jumping and arm swings grant Haste X and Speed III, with instant mining including bedrock. Every block of travel, mining or placement grants 1,000 XP and permanently adds 0.1 max health and 0.01 luck. Luck improves pact gifts.
